description: Get the live price and payment options for buying MyOTP credits, without making a purchase. Use this when generate_otp or another send fails with HTTP 403 insufficient balance / NoBalance, or before calling `top_up_credits` to show the cost. Returns USDC and card client commands and never exposes the configured API key.

credits.description: Number of credits to quote. Integer from 25 to 50,000; defaults to 100.

name: get_topup_quote

amount_usd.description: Total price in US dollars, as a decimal string.

how_to_pay.description: Ready-to-run client commands for this amount.

card.description: Stripe Link CLI command that pays the challenge by card.

usdc.description: mppx command that pays the challenge in USDC on Tempo.

methods.description: Human-readable list of the accepted payment methods.

rules.description: Top-up limits: unit price, minimum, maximum and the card cap.

title: Get a MyOTP credit top-up quote
